SELECT t.terminal_id , t.terminal_name , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = '통합제어보드' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'ctlBoard' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = '스마트스크린' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'smartscreen' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = '재실감지카메라' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'cv' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = '승하차알림시스템' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'ledPanel' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = '공기질표출장치' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'lcdDisplay' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = 'LTE라우터' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'lteRouter' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = '공공WI-FI' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'lteRouter2' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = 'LED전등' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'ledLight' , MAX(CASE WHEN d.device_name = '냉각FAN' THEN d.has_device ELSE NULL END) AS 'fan' FROM tb_terminal t LEFT JOIN tb_terminal_devices d ON t.terminal_id = d.terminal_id WHERE 1=1
AND t.terminal_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{s_terminalId}, '%')
AND t.terminal_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{s_terminalNm}, '%')
GROUP BY t.terminal_id, t.terminal_name ORDER BY t.terminal_id ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
